story_description: Install compiled hooks into Claude Code, manage scope, and visualize active hooks.
task_description: Users need a visual map of all active hooks across the CLI lifecycle so they can see which events are already hooked and avoid duplicate automation.
atom_description: Users need a visual map of all active hooks across the CLI lifecycle so they can see which events are already hooked and avoid duplicate automation.
problem_statement: Users need a visual map of all active hooks across the CLI lifecycle so they can see which events are already hooked and avoid duplicate automation.
scope_in: Visual map of hook events, show hooks attached to each event, highlight scope and enabled status
Implement HooksLifecycleMapView.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Editing hook node graphs (handled by HooksBuilderView)
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: InstalledHookSummary provides event name and scope
Hook event list matches Claude Code lifecycle events in F005-R000
Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Must render all hook events in order: PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd
Must visually distinguish user vs project scope
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must support keyboard navigation (accessibility)
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
At least one event node per graph
UpdatedInput only under PreToolUse or PermissionRequest with allow
Stop gate only under Stop or SubagentStop with loop safety
Conflict resolution: continue false wins, deny beats allow, ask beats allow, PostToolUse block forces remediation
Exit 0 success, stdout visible in verbose; UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart may inject into context
Exit 2 blocks with error handling per event
Other exit codes are non-blocking and continue execution
Event nodes: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd
Filter nodes: Matcher and Predicate
Action nodes: Command, Prompt, Agent
Control nodes: Decision Allow Deny Ask, Permission Decision, Block with Reason, Continue or Stop
Transformation nodes: Updated Input, Additional Context, System Message
Utility nodes: Logger, Export Trace, Rate limit or Debounce
Left panel node palette with Events, Filters, Actions, Utilities
Center panel canvas with pan, zoom, and grid background
Right panel inspector with node properties, tooltips, and validation errors
Top bar actions: Back, Save, Discard, Test run, Export
Space plus drag to pan canvas
Cmd plus scroll to zoom
Cmd C and Cmd V to copy and paste nodes
Delete to remove node
Cmd S to save, Cmd Enter to test run, Cmd Z to undo, Cmd Shift Z to redo
Cmd I to focus inspector, M to toggle minimap
functional_requirements: Render a timeline or swimlane map of hook events
Show hook badges on each event with name, scope, and enabled status
Provide filters for scope and event type
Allow clicking a hook badge to open its configuration in the builder
Show counts per event to indicate coverage
Support all hook events: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd.
Support node taxonomy for events, filters, actions, control, transformation, and utility nodes.
Persist graph with nodes and edges and validate against semantic rules.
nonfunctional_requirements: Interactive hit targets meet accessibility requirements
implementation_steps: Create `HooksLifecycleMapView.swift` and define event order list
Group installed hooks by event and scope
Render event lanes with badges for hooks
Add filters for scope and enabled status
Add tap handling to open the hook in the builder
Add legend for scope colors and status
api_contracts: Output: Selection callback with hook ID
ui_states: Loaded: Map with event lanes and hook badges
Filtered: Map updates to show selected scope/event
Idle saved state with no unsaved changes
Dirty state with unsaved changes and save enabled
Validating state during schema and semantic checks
Error state with validation errors and save disabled
Saving and Saved states with success toast
Discard confirm modal when leaving with unsaved changes
ui_interactions: Click hook badge -> open builder at that hook
Hover event -> show tooltip with event definition
Drag nodes from palette to canvas and connect ports to create edges.
Select node to edit config in inspector with tooltips and examples.
Run test execution and display validation results.
ui_copy: Empty: "No hooks installed. Build a hook to populate the map."
Top bar buttons: Back, Save, Discard, Test run, Export.
Inspector shows short tooltip and long learn more text for each node.
edge_cases: Many hooks on one event - wrap badges or provide scroll
Unknown event name in hooks.json - show under "Other"
Disabled hooks - gray badges but still visible
failure_modes: Map render fails due to bad data - show error state and refresh button
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
rollback_plan: Replace map with a simple grouped list

unit: Group hooks by event and scope correctly
Unit test core logic for HooksLifecycleMapView.swift with representative inputs.
integration: Map updates when hooks list changes
Integration test HooksLifecycleMapView.swift with dependent stores or managers.
ui: Verify SwiftUI previews render without crash.
security: No hook command contents displayed by default
Ensure no sensitive data is logged.
